verses.html: 1 Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
verses.text: 1 Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.

verses.html: 2 When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?
verses.text: 2 When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?

verses.html: 3 Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.
verses.text: 3 Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.

verses.html: 4 Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
verses.text: 4 Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”

verses.html: 5 So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
verses.text: 5 So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.

verses.html: 6 And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He went around from village to village, teaching the people.
verses.text: 6 And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He went around from village to village, teaching the people.

verses.html: 1 And he went out from there and comes to his hometown, and his disciples are following him.
verses.text: 1 And he went out from there and comes to his hometown, and his disciples are following him.

verses.html: 2 And a Sabbath having come, he began to teach in the synagogue. And the many ones hearing him were astonished, saying, “From where to this one {are} these things, and what {is} the wisdom that has been given to this one, and such miracles happening by his hands?
verses.text: 2 And a Sabbath having come, he began to teach in the synagogue. And the many ones hearing him were astonished, saying, “From where to this one {are} these things, and what {is} the wisdom that has been given to this one, and such miracles happening by his hands?

verses.html: 3 Is this not the carpenter, the son of Mary and a brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? And are his sisters not here with us?” And they were being caused to stumble on him.
verses.text: 3 Is this not the carpenter, the son of Mary and a brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? And are his sisters not here with us?” And they were being caused to stumble on him.

verses.html: 4 And Jesus was saying to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and among his relatives and in his house.”
verses.text: 4 And Jesus was saying to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and among his relatives and in his house.”

verses.html: 5 And he was not able to do any miracle there, except, having laid his hands on a few sick people, he healed {them}.
verses.text: 5 And he was not able to do any miracle there, except, having laid his hands on a few sick people, he healed {them}.

verses.html: 6 And he was amazed because of their unbelief. And he was going around the villages in a circle teaching.
verses.text: 6 And he was amazed because of their unbelief. And he was going around the villages in a circle teaching.

verses.html: 1 After that, Jesus left {the city of Capernaum}. He traveled to {the city of Nazareth,} where he had grown up. His apprentices went with him.
verses.text: 1 After that, Jesus left {the city of Capernaum}. He traveled to {the city of Nazareth,} where he had grown up. His apprentices went with him.

verses.html: 2 When it was the Jewish day of rest, he started to instruct the people there when they gathered in the Jewish meeting place. What they heard him say impressed the many people {who were there}. They said {to each other}, “We do not know how this man is able to do what he does. We do not know how he is so wise and does such powerful things.
verses.text: 2 When it was the Jewish day of rest, he started to instruct the people there when they gathered in the Jewish meeting place. What they heard him say impressed the many people {who were there}. They said {to each other}, “We do not know how this man is able to do what he does. We do not know how he is so wise and does such powerful things.

verses.html: 3 He is just a woodworker! He is Mary’s son, and he is an {older} brother to James, Joses, Judas, and Simon. His {younger} sisters live here in our town.” So, these people rejected Jesus.
verses.text: 3 He is just a woodworker! He is Mary’s son, and he is an {older} brother to James, Joses, Judas, and Simon. His {younger} sisters live here in our town.” So, these people rejected Jesus.

verses.html: 4 So, Jesus told them, “The only ones who do not respect people who speak for God are those from where they grew up, their clans, and their own families.”
verses.text: 4 So, Jesus told them, “The only ones who do not respect people who speak for God are those from where they grew up, their clans, and their own families.”

verses.html: 5 Jesus could do very few powerful things in that place. He only touched a few people who were sick and cured them.
verses.text: 5 Jesus could do very few powerful things in that place. He only touched a few people who were sick and cured them.

verses.html: 6 How little the people trusted him surprised Jesus. After that, Jesus traveled through the small towns in that area, and he instructed the people there.
verses.text: 6 How little the people trusted him surprised Jesus. After that, Jesus traveled through the small towns in that area, and he instructed the people there.
